recent.text: Halftime: Pistons 68, Wizards 58. Highest-scoring 1st half of the season, with Collins (15 pts, 4 rebs) and Robinson (14 pts) leading the way. Won the 2nd quarter 37-26. AD’s been unstoppable (30 pts, 8 rebs). Pistons have otherwise been solid defensively.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Robinson's back
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 1: Wizards 32, Pistons 31. Wizards took their first lead with a 3 from Young at the 30.7 mark. Pistons have given up too many open shots, Wizards are shooting 56.5% overall. JB hasn’t been pleased with the defensive intensity. Collins: 9 pts, 4-5 overall
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Daniss and Collins are showing some chemistry together. Collins has 9 of the Pistons' 16 points on 4-4 shooting. In the right spots and aggressive.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Already a better start than last night. Collins has 7 of the Pistons' 10 points and is 3-3 from the floor. Pistons are 4-6 overall
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Collins opens the game with a corner 3 and lob from Daniss. Pistons getting him involved early
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Neither Collins or Reed address the size and rebounding weaknesses at the five. They don't play particularly well together. Makes sense to separate them
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Daniss replaces Paul Reed in the starting lineup
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Kevin Huerter was everywhere last night, on both ends: 24 points, five assists, five rebounds, five blocks, two steals. The vet showed, again, why he was a priority at the trade deadline and re-signed to a three-year deal this offseason. https://t.co/A8cRUSQaFh
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: RT @freepsports: Kevin Huerter discusses his improved two-way play after Lakers loss https://t.co/YYDHrtgDAw
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Pistons to record at least five blocks in a game since the 2016-17 season: Drummond (11x) Stewart (6x) Duren (2x) Thompson (1x) Huerter (tonight)
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: JB talks the loss and Huerter and Jenkins stepping up: “They brought us an energy lift, a spirit that we needed.” https://t.co/Nh5EmTnatm
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Jenkins on scoring a career-high 31 tonight: "When you try to muck the game up like that, it’s a lot of open shots out there. I just tried to move and play within the flow of the game. Just so happened tonight that they were 3s."
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Jenkins said the Lakers "mucked" the game up early with their defense. "They do a good job of making you see bodies and making you make the right play every time."
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: FINAL: Lakers 121, Pistons 116. Trailed by 26 early in the 2nd, couldn't rally back. Jenkins (31 points, 8 made 3-pointers) and Huerter (22 points, 5 assists, 5 blocks and 2 steals) were bright spots. Awful night from the starters and Cade (14 points, 8 assts, 6-15 overall).
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Kevin Huerter out here having a GAME 🔹19 PTS 🔹4 REB 🔹4 AST 🔹2 STL 🔹5 BLK (career-high) 🔹7-10 FG 🔹3-6 3PT https://t.co/0mWowWGmyd
recent.author: Detroit Pistons

recent.text: That touchdown pass from Huerter was nuts
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Most backup point guards do not hit big shots as often as Jenkins does. Rises to the moment
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Jenkins' eighth 3-pointer of the night cuts it to two, 88-86. He has 28 points
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Javonte Green goes coast to coast 🔥 https://t.co/zEeaUlVLpb
recent.author: Detroit Pistons

recent.text: End of 3: Lakers 88, Pistons 81. Used a 20-6 run to help cut a 26-point deficit to single digits. Jenkins (25 pts, 4 assts, 7-11 from 3) and Huerter (19 pts, 4 assts, 7-9 overall) are leading the offense.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: This game is showing why the Pistons re-signed Huerter to a three-year deal. He has 19 points, 4 assists, 3 blocks and 2 steals on 7-9 overall shooting. He and Jenkins are the reason this is a game.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Green steal, Green dunk. Pistons stop, Robinson dunk. Huerter steal, Huerter layup. Pistons' defense is firing with Ausar in at the 5, and they're on an 18-6 run to cut it to five, 84-79
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: That pass from Huerter was gorgeous. One-handed, no-look over his head. Found Daniss in the corner for his seventh 3 of the night. They've been their best players tonight.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II
